summary: Checks your films and series for damaged files each Sunday night and lists them, without changing anything.
does: Checkrr reads each file in your movies and tv folders every Sunday night and checks that it is a film or episode that can be read. It lists the files that fail, with the reason.

It only reports. It never deletes, moves, renames or replaces a file, and it reads your folders read only. Replacing a damaged file is up to you. A file cut short part way through can still pass, because it does not play each file through.
for: People who want to know before a film night that a file will not play, for example after a failing disk or a download that went wrong.
needs: Nothing else beyond Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later, and films and series in the movies and tv folders of your media folder. It is given no Reelix, Radarr or Sonarr.
shows: One dashboard card, Damaged files, with how many files failed the last check and how many were checked. Its tab has a Files that failed the check page, grouped into Films and Series with the reason, a Check now button, and an Open link to its own page.
unclear: Its card status table lists Warning, Scanning, Idle and Waiting: are these the final names shown to users?
Media servers: Checkrr checks media files and is not tied to one server. Show all three?
